tool_selection.reasoning: SHAP provides intuition about feature importance and direction of influence, especially useful for identifying whether 'hours-per-week' pushes the model toward >50K. These tools together provide both interpretability and measurement of impact, which is critical when the baseline prediction is uncertain (0.53 confidence).
